feature: iPhone and iPad Save to folder controls

scenarios.name: Reveal folder consent and preserve recovery after cancelling the picker
scenarios.given: Save to folder is off in a scrollable Settings form and no folder has been selected
scenarios.when: the user reads the folder disclosure, turns saving on and cancels the native Files folder picker
scenarios.then: the disclosure and complete controls are reachable by scrolling, saving remains enabled but asks for a folder, and Choose folder remains visibly available without starting capture
